high_value_repos.name: codebase-memory-mcp
high_value_repos.reason: High-performance code intelligence MCP server with 158 language support, 15 MCP tools, sub-ms queries, persistent knowledge graph. Ships as single binary. Integrates directly with JARVIS for code understanding.

high_value_repos.name: erpnext-mcp-server
high_value_repos.reason: Full ERPNext/Frappe API integration via MCP. 12 tools for document CRUD, reports, and custom methods. Enables JARVIS to manage business operations directly.

high_value_repos.name: facebook-mcp-server
high_value_repos.reason: Comprehensive Facebook MCP server with 30+ tools for posts, comments, insights, moderation, and sentiment filtering. Direct integration with JARVIS social media automation.

high_value_repos.name: kadenzo-mcp
high_value_repos.reason: Multi-social posting across 11 networks from a single MCP server. Schedule, manage, generate & analyze social posts. Key integration for JARVIS social media automation.

high_value_repos.name: frappe-framework-api
high_value_repos.reason: Frappe Framework API assistant - same ecosystem as ERPNext. Provides comprehensive API access to Frappe framework. Duplicate of erpnext-mcp-server functionality.

medium_value_repos.name: polar-ble-sdk
medium_value_repos.reason: Official Polar BLE SDK for Android/iOS. Provides real-time heart rate, ECG, accelerometer, PPG data. Useful for JARVIS wearable integration but requires native mobile app - not direct API integration.

medium_value_repos.name: mcp-proxy
medium_value_repos.reason: Rust-based MCP proxy server with fastembed for local embeddings. Useful for bridging MCP servers and generating embeddings without external API calls. Good for self-hosted JARVIS.

medium_value_repos.name: nuwax-mobile
medium_value_repos.reason: Mobile MCP client. Enables JARVIS to interact with mobile devices. Useful for on-device AI integration.

medium_value_repos.name: engram
medium_value_repos.reason: Memory system for AI agents. Could enhance JARVIS's long-term memory capabilities. Requires further investigation.

medium_value_repos.name: social-cli-mcp
medium_value_repos.reason: CLI-based social media MCP. Provides command-line interface for social media operations. Complementary to Kadenzo for power users.

medium_value_repos.name: OpenAI-Agents-SDK
medium_value_repos.reason: Reference implementation for multi-agent management patterns. Useful for understanding OpenAI Agents SDK patterns that can be applied to JARVIS multi-agent orchestration.

low_value_repos.name: mindspore-tools-mcp
low_value_repos.reason: Huawei MindSpore specific MCP tools. Limited applicability unless using Huawei AI infrastructure. Not directly useful for JARVIS ecosystem.

low_value_repos.name: baselight-mcp
low_value_repos.reason: MCP server for Baselight color grading software. Very niche use case for film production. Not directly applicable to JARVIS automation.

recommendations: Integrate codebase-memory-mcp as primary code intelligence tool - 158 languages, zero dependencies
Use facebook-mcp-server patterns for comprehensive social media automation
Adopt kadenzo-mcp for multi-network social posting (11 networks)
Use mcp-proxy with fastembed for local embeddings (no API costs)
Polar BLE SDK requires native mobile app - use Polar Flow API instead for server-side
Skip mindspore-tools-mcp and baselight-mcp - too niche for JARVIS
